cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: the nave of a Gothic cathedral with stained-glass windows — sitting on the ground; a quiet orbital recreation room with a tabletop wire-loop steady-hand puzzle and a small unlettered indicator lamp — she tests her famous precision on a harmless wire-loop puzzle; her compact orbital apartment's utility alcove — she stops a newly laundered sock drifting into a ventilation grille by trapping it gently under an empty mesh laundry basket; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — standing; an airport lounge — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — standing; a space-station docking bay with a sleek shuttle on its pad and long light strips — standing; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — sitting on the ground; a castle bathhouse with a stone pool — perched on a ledge or edge; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — writes in a notebook with a pen on the table; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — holds her keepsake at chest height; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height
